description: Verify that TCP in SYN-SENT ignores a segment carrying both ACK and RST flags with an unacceptable ACK number (RFC 793 §3.9 p66)
approach:
[Objective]
In SYN-SENT, a stray ACK,RST whose ack_num doesn't acknowledge the DUT's SYN is suspicious — could be a spoof. RFC 793 §3.9 mandates ignore.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT active OPEN → DUT in SYN-SENT.
2. Tester → DUT: ACK+RST with unacceptable ack number.
3. Observation: DUT must NOT respond (silently dropped).

[Pass condition]
No DUT response to the bogus ACK+RST.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_dut_syn — active OPEN didn't even produce SYN
• Fail_unexpected_response — DUT emitted any reply to the bogus ACK+RST

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently ignored bogus ACK+RST in SYN-SENT — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_dut_syn: No DUT SYN to active OPEN
verdicts.Fail_unexpected_response: DUT emitted response to ACK+RST with unacceptable ack
